note: San Diego County park surrounded by Anza-Borrego Desert State Park, known for its geothermal mineral pools (an indoor spa for ages 14 and up, outdoor pools with campers-only evening hours). Hookup sites are 1-51 (electric and water) and 66-92 (full hookups). Pads run 25-40 ft, but partial sites 12, 13, 19-21 and 34 are under 23 ft. Sites are not completely level, so bring levelling blocks. No cell reception. --Claude
